english.note: This is the all-purpose adjective for something that causes actual harm or damage.
Use this as the all-purpose direct equivalent, especially in warnings or when the harmful effect is stated generally.
Use this when the emphasis is on something causing harm or damage, especially an environment or situation.
Use this when adverse means harmful, especially to health, safety, or well-being.
Use this for something harmful or having a negative effect rather than for literal poison.

examples.english: This cleaning product is detrimental to your skin, so remember to wear gloves.
examples.traditional: 呢種清潔劑對皮膚有害，記住戴手套。
examples.jyutping: ne1 zung2 cing1 git3 zai1 deoi3 pei4 fu1 jau5 hoi6 gei3 zyu6 daai3 sau2 tou3
